name: PWA DETAIL NAVIGATION UX
changes: Adds explicit Back and Close controls to mobile Client 360 detail navigation
Turns mobile order details into a history-aware PWA detail screen with Back, Close and iOS browser swipe-back support
Restores the originating admin view, filters and scroll position after leaving order details
Removes blur from mobile detail navigation and order close controls while keeping the Overview header unchanged
notes: Frontend/admin navigation-only release based on v16.4.8.
No Supabase migration, Edge Function, table, grant, RLS policy, Monobank, Nova Poshta or VAcleaner runtime change.
Adds a permanent regression test for PWA detail Back/Close/history behavior.
